title: 영역 믹스 솔로 #097 · 광택 소재 믹스 · 세로 띠·매끈 · 5영역(코발트 에나멜+은박+로즈골드 박+금박+루비 에나멜) · 풀커버 · apex siren · 왼 힙 팝 · Middle Eastern · 배경 열대 정글 보드워크 · 브리티시 모드
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, early 30s goddess, apex siren physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily tall and curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; everything about her is at its extreme at once: a towering frame with endless legs, a colossal heavy bust wider than her shoulders, a waist cinched to an impossible minimum, enormous round hips and a high rounded rear, gigantic thick thighs pressed together, smooth glowing skin over soft full curves; her silhouette is an exaggerated hourglass that dominates the whole frame from head to toe; her head looks small above her body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long straight dark brown hair — her body is covered in 5 different shiny materials at once, each material claiming its own region of her figure. Her figure is divided into 5 vertical bands by 4 hazy transition zones centred about 9% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 21% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 46% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 92% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries cobalt-blue high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries applied silver leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright cool silver sheen. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries applied rose-gold leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright rose-gold sheen. Region 4 is the strip between transition zone 3 and transition zone 4: it carries applied 24K gold leaf, thin irregular sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, a bright gold sheen. Region 5 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries deep ruby-red high-gloss enamel, a wet-looking mirror-glossy coat. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring materials blend along the edge: the edge of one reaches into the other and the two simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course, every material laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: strong hip pop left, both hands pressing outer hips outward arching back to extreme, her legs fully in view — most extreme apex siren silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each longer than her middle finger, in navy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a bold black graphic crease line drawn high above each eyelid, very thick false lashes on the top lids, small painted lash strokes beneath each lower lid, soft lilac-white eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, natural brows, a soft peachy-white lip.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows sweaty oiled skin, post-workout glistening.

Background: a bright tropical jungle boardwalk of wooden planks with a waist-high rope rail, large green leaves and standard-height steps, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
